### Data upload

Please prepare your data in an Excel file with the same format as shown below.

```{r V2_upload, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

x <- cbind("Property" = "measurand name", "Unit" = "measurand unit", init_V2_data()[1:16,])
ft <- show_upload_example_table(x=x, max_char = 15, optional = c(1,2,7,8)) |>
  flextable::set_caption(flextable::as_paragraph(
    flextable::as_b("Info"), " Example table layout for validation data upload"
  )) |>
  flextable::htmltools_value(ft, ft.align = "left")
```

The optional columns are depicted in grey. Column order is not relevant but 
column names are. 'Lab' and 'Level' can be specified as number or text, 
'Replicate' and 'Value' have to be numbers.
